summary: Corporate cards and spend management platform with expenses, bill pay, travel and banking APIs.
access_note: Account or card admin must accept the Developer API agreement and create a user token; OAuth for partner apps needs Brex approval and staging credentials.
blocker_note: User tokens only work for the creating company's admin; OAuth to authenticate other Brex accounts requires partner application and approval.

evidence.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
is used when building partner applications to authenticate other Brex accounts.
Once your application is approved, you'll receive credentials for the staging environment using SendSafely.
This is different from the Brex Developer API, which requires admin-provisioned API tokens.
Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.
The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account

notes: Brex MCP is beta and needs the 'Brex in AI assistants' beta enabled; once on, any employee can connect via OAuth.
